updates.title: Powhatan office opens late November 9–10
updates.body: The park office opens at 11 a.m. on November 9 and 10. Park hours remain dawn to dusk.
updates.evidence: The park office will open at 11 a.m. on Nov. 9 and 10.

updates.title: Martin’s Station and Pioneer Trail closed through November 15
updates.body: Martin’s Station and the Pioneer Trail are closed to park guests Nov. 12–15 for volunteer training and the Forting Up program.
updates.evidence: Due to volunteer training and the "Forting Up" program, Martin's Station and Pioneer Trail will be closed to park guest Nov 12-15.

updates.title: Highland’s last admission is 1:30 p.m. on November 14
updates.body: A private afternoon event moves Highland’s last admission to 1:30 p.m. on Saturday, November 14.
updates.evidence: Due to a private afternoon event, Highland’s last admission on Saturday, November 14 will be at 1:30 PM.
